title: Emoji escaped the chat
dek: five playable prototypes for tiny public culture
body:
Slackmojis are still one of the internet's great handmade folk archives: specific, excessive, useful, strange. PUBLIC MOODS asks what happens after the file library. What if an emoji becomes a tiny public behavior?

Five answers are live. Vibecast puts a feeling on the public air. Tiny Parade makes a procession someone else can extend. Public Bench leaves a place-signal. Family Tree keeps the credit attached to every mutation. Tiny Shrine gives one small thing a ceremonial URL.

Each mode carries its state in the link, so the object travels without an account. Open it, change it, send it onward. The first version is deliberately light: public links now, shared persistence when one of the five earns it.

Made in El Segundo. Share, remix, return.
author: mh+cc
source: Mike chat 2026-07-18: 'making the emojis public ... slackmojis are amazing and still very 1.0 ... try 5 prototypes' followed by 'yeep going add to pointcast'
